summary_1line: Janamejaya asks for the full account of the fateful dice game as Dhritarashtra debates and Duryodhana reveals jealousy of Yudhishthira’s prosperity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vidura stands before the blind king Dhritarashtra in the royal hall, warning him against the coming gambling match.
Duryodhana bitterly recounts Yudhishthira’s immense wealth, recalling heaps of jewels brought as tribute while courtiers wait as his hands tire from receiving them.
